title: The package-manager guard follows cd
notes: Retro 2026-11-24: new-crm has package-lock.json at its root and pnpm-lock.yaml in backoffice/ and storefront/. 'cd storefront && pnpm install' was refused 4 times ('lockfile is package-lock.json: install with npm'), so #1279 went to CI unchecked. src/main/workflow/package-manager-guard.ts judges the session's folder; follow the command's cd the way test-run-guard.ts does since 92f7e4ad, with a test for 'cd storefront && pnpm install'.

comments.body: Pull request #349 opened: Follow a cd in the package-manager guard https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/349
